            The network's figures
            
Reading the validator set…

          

          
Bonding locks SAT (Satoshi, the native token your node mines to this wallet) as your
            validator weight and turns this node into a validator (permissionless-by-bond) — the same full node with
            the added role. One bond asset, like THORChain's RUNE: SAT is not a claim on the reserve it secures, so a
            takeover has to buy it outright. Your SAT weighs both the reserve's custody tally and finality. Holding SAT
            is the default — bonding is your choice, and the bond stays yours: the carrier welds your public weight to
            the value you lock (no over-claim), one note per bond, and your spend key never leaves this device. USDm
            earns through staking and liquidity instead.

        

        
Delegate SAT

        

          
Earn with your SAT without running a validatorValidators: —

          
          
          
          
          

          
You have no delegated SAT.

          

          
Delegating adds your SAT to a validator's custody weight and earns the bonders' share of every
            network fee. The validator never holds your SAT: it stays a note only you can spend back. Undelegating takes 21 days,
            then your SAT returns to your balance by itself. You earn at your validator's uptime, and the wallet moves you off one
            that goes quiet. If it double-signs or deals a bad key, only its own bond is burned and your SAT comes back; if it helps
            steal from the reserve, the SAT delegated to it is lost with it — spreading across validators is the default.

        

        
Votes

        
        

          

            
Proposals

            
A change passes when two thirds of the validators and two thirds of the miners vote for it.

          

          
Reading proposals…

          

          

            Propose a change
            

              
              
            

            
          

          
Your validator-chamber vote weight = your bonded stake; each vote is ML-DSA
            signed by your spend key (which never leaves this device). A proposal enacts only when BOTH chambers
            (miners ⊥ validators) reach 2/3 — anti-capture by design.

Auto-OPSEC: on
              
              Each piece pays in a random batch within 24 hours, among many same-size payouts, to a fresh address — automatically.

            
            

            

            
Cashing out burns your USDm in standard-size pieces (a real PQ nullifier
              spend per piece, ML-DSA signed on this device) and the PQ-FROST reserve quorum pays each piece to its
              own fresh address in a random batch — no single party controls it, nothing links your pieces to your deposit,
              and the USDm supply falls by exactly what you cash out. Anything below the smallest piece stays USDm.

To use this seed on a second phone or computer at the same time, press
            Add a device here on your first device, wait until it confirms, then restore the seed on the new
            device: it claims its own slot, so the two devices never link each other's payments. Restoring the seed
            with no add waiting makes that device your primary; do not keep using this seed on the old primary
            device after that.

        

        
Verify all funds (sound scan)

        

          
          
—

          
Your everyday balance is a fast preview that trusts each note's detection clue to
            skip work. This runs the authoritative scan: it decapsulates every served note locally and
            ignores the clue, so no corrupted or withheld clue — from a sender or a node — can hide a note you own.
            Your scan key never leaves this device.
